title: factory.work-plan/v1 output artifact — ordered dispatchable-ticket plan with one chained dispatch target (WM-110)

recommendation.description: DISPATCH when at least one Todo + ai:agent-ready + unassigned ticket fits the per-repo in-flight cap with Owned Paths disjoint from all in-flight work; LOW_SUPPLY when there are zero ready candidates (after complete filtering, before cap/overlap pruning) and a non-empty complete Triage backlog; NOOP otherwise with a typed noopReason

repo.description: Echo of the short repo name from the input

ticket.description: The plan's first ticket — the single target the chain edge feeds into factory.dispatch.requested (chain.mjs emits exactly one chain event per run); must equal plan[0].ticket, null on NOOP

plan.description: Queue-ordered tickets using explicit Linear priority rank Urgent (1), High (2), Medium (3), Low (4), No priority (0), then createdAt ascending. Every item is dispatchable right now: state exactly Todo, label ai:agent-ready present, and assignee null; within the per-repo in-flight cap; Owned Paths mutually disjoint and disjoint from every in-flight ticket's paths. Item order is dispatch order; only the first item chains this run

ticket.description: Linear issue identifier, dispatchable at scan time: state exactly Todo, label ai:agent-ready present, and assignee field null

ownedPaths.description: The ticket's Owned Paths globs as parsed at scan time — the disjointness evidence this plan rests on; a ticket with no parseable section owns everything (["**"]) and can only ever be planned alone

items.description: One Owned Paths glob, verified against the pinned tree at ./repo

reason.description: One line of why this ticket made the plan at this position, naming its priority by label (Urgent, High, Medium, Low, or No priority) rather than only by number, plus age and path disjointness

deferred.description: Tickets after the first plan item: selected but NOT chained this run — chain.mjs emits one chain event per run, so only plan[0] becomes a factory.dispatch.requested; rolling dispatch re-fires the scan after each completion and re-plans these against a fresh world

items.description: Linear issue identifier of a planned-but-deferred ticket (echo of a plan[1..] item's ticket)

readyCandidates.description: Count after a complete read is filtered to state exactly Todo, label ai:agent-ready present, and assignee null, before cap/overlap pruning

triageBacklog.description: Count of remaining Triage issues read from Linear in a complete read

summary.description: One line an operator can act on

noopReason.description: Typed reason accompanying a NOOP — no Todo + ai:agent-ready + unassigned tickets exist, the per-repo in-flight cap is already full, or every dispatchable ticket's Owned Paths collide with in-flight work or with each other
